title: Daytime Dehazing Local Restoration Need Qualification v2
rationale: Use only program-local development-screening scenes to decide whether a fixed dehazing baseline has a repeatable and practically useful spatial residual-strength calibration problem rather than a measurement, aggregation, context, or global-difficulty artifact. This revised S1 keeps the v1 scene, variant, crop, estimand, uncertainty, and decision rules, but repairs the pre-inference validity veto by consuming the outcome-blind RESIDE pairing-v2 ledger exactly: 300 clear scenes, 600 nested haze observations, fixed relative paths, file SHA-256, decoded RGB SHA-256, dimensions, and scoring geometry. The privileged diagnostic uses five local residual strengths with two-way 8-by-8 macroblock cross-fitting inside 4-by-4 cell cores and compares pooled evaluation-pixel SSE with a stronger 1001-point scene-global scalar grid. The official ConvIR-B model now runs on each complete padded image before the frozen square scoring crop is extracted, matching the authorized pairing-v2 input contract and the device-aware synthetic capability fixture. A spatially permuted action-map control, shifted-target selection null, explicit unresolved label, near-clear exposure/damage/conditional-mitigation decomposition, negative-tail control, and compact endpoint/saturation/edge/clipping diagnostics constrain alternative explanations. The route trains no network, tests no observable signal, proposes no post-processing method, and cannot access confirmation, NH-Haze, or sealed-final images. PASS authorizes only authoring an S2 mechanism-discovery contract; a valid scientific FAIL rejects this first operationalization without spending the predeclared second S1 attempt automatically.

scientific_contract.question: Across development-only Haze4K, RESIDE ITS, and RESIDE OTS scenes, does the fixed ConvIR-B baseline exhibit same-scene, cross-observation repeatable spatial need for weaker, positively supported unchanged, and stronger residual restoration, with material privileged utility over one scene-global strength on a frozen dense scalar grid, spatial specificity beyond a permuted action map, and an interpretable near-clear fidelity outcome?

intervention.primary_variable: privileged cross-fitted local scaling of the fixed official ConvIR-B restoration residual
intervention.reference: the optimistic best single alpha on a frozen 1001-point [0.5, 1.5] scene-global grid, selected by the same cross-fit split and evaluated on exactly the same pixels; keep alpha is 1.0
intervention.matched_budget: 150 original-clear development scenes per dataset, exactly two outcome-blind haze observations per scene, 16 nested spatial cells per observation, five fixed local strengths, and one dense scene-global scalar comparator
fixed_factors: the official ConvIR-B base architecture and official Haze4K checkpoint remain frozen and strictly loaded
the diagnostic candidate is clip(hazy plus alpha times official-output-minus-hazy, 0, 1)
the local alpha grid is exactly 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, and 1.5; the stronger global comparator uses 1001 values from 0.5 through 1.5 at step 0.001

every image is padded to a multiple of 32 and passed through the complete official ConvIR-B graph before one outcome-blind deterministic square scoring crop, whose side is the largest multiple of 32 not exceeding 512 or either image dimension and is at least 256, is extracted and shared by its two nested haze observations
four-by-four equal-area cells score the central 75 percent of each side, exactly 56.25 percent of cell area, without claiming or applying a taper

opposite 8-by-8 macroblock-checkerboard halves select and evaluate alpha in both directions; local ties within 0.005 dB prefer keep and then smaller alpha, while the dense global tie tolerance is 0.0001 dB

a non-keep cell is supported only when both halves select the same exact alpha and both opposite-half gains are at least 0.05 dB; keep_supported requires both halves to select 1.0 and every non-keep alternative to improve by no more than 0.02 dB on both halves; all other cells are unresolved

local and global evaluation-half SSE are pooled over identical scored pixels before one PSNR-ratio conversion; the two nested observation values are averaged and only the primary, transfer, and spatial-specificity scene values are clipped to minus 0.25 through plus 0.25 dB

Haze4K uses its fixed 150 development scenes under the original v1 salts; ITS and OTS use exactly the 150 plus 150 scenes and two nested observations per scene recorded in the SHA-bound pairing-v2 mapping ledger, with no directory scan, filename rematching, eligibility backfill, or variant reselection

the pairing-v2 relative paths must resolve inside six separately bound official RESIDE clear and haze roots; decoded clear RGB must match each S0 canonical_digest, while every clear and haze file SHA-256, decoded RGB SHA-256, dimension, padded shape, and scoring crop is verified before model loading and file hashes are rechecked around every scene
the original clear scene is the only independent unit; haze observations, cells, pixels, actions, and resamples are nested
GT selects only this offline diagnostic oracle and is prohibited as an inference-time signal or proposed module input
confirmation, sealed-final, NH-Haze, canary, and locked-test images remain absent and unread

primary_estimand.aggregation: equal-weight mean of the three dataset-specific means of scene-level two-observation local-versus-global PSNR ratios; within each observation, local-selected and dense-global-selected SSE are pooled over identical opposite-half pixels before one logarithm, then the observation values are averaged and clipped to [-0.25, 0.25] dB

controls: typed S0 PASS, S1-v1 pre-inference validity terminal, pairing-v2 PASS authorization, compact parent summaries, cloud-only scene-role ledger, and pairing mapping ledger identities must match their frozen SHA-256 values
only the predeclared first 150 retained development_screening scene IDs per stratum may reach inference; missing, replaced, or duplicate observations never trigger backfill

every selected decoded clear image must match its S0 canonical RGB digest, every RESIDE decoded haze image must match its pairing-v2 RGB digest, and one pre-inference roster digest binds the pairing-ledger SHA plus all selected filenames and clear and haze file SHA-256 values
strict official architecture, source, layer, checkpoint, runtime-environment, and entrypoint identities
the dense best single alpha selected with identical macroblock cross-fitting is an optimistic global-difficulty control and has strictly more scalar choices than the local oracle
alpha selection against the clear target circularly shifted by half the image in both axes is the fixed measurement-null control and is evaluated against the correct target
a deterministic five-cell cyclic permutation of the selected local action map must lose at least 0.05 dB, testing whether utility is spatially located rather than caused only by the action histogram

two deterministic haze observations per original clear scene test direction and exact-alpha repeatability without increasing independent sample size; each observation-derived supported map is also transferred to the other observation and compared with that target observation's in-sample dense global oracle
weaken, keep_supported, strengthen, and unresolved labels use frozen positive evidence rules; unresolved never contributes to stability or keep prevalence
near-clear exposure, repeatable baseline damage, and damage-conditional mitigation are separate scene estimands; absence of material damage is safe_no_material_damage rather than unsafe
endpoint-alpha frequency, unresolved-cell frequency, exact-alpha agreement, selected-candidate saturation, primary clipping, and edge-versus-interior effects are archived as compact diagnostics
all bootstrap and Wilson uncertainty remains grouped at the original-clear-scene level and reports overall equal-dataset and dataset-specific support
no network training, signal prediction, threshold search, mechanism selection, output image save, or per-cell GitHub evidence

gates.reference: S0, S1-v1 validity, and pairing-v2 typed authorizations; all compact parent files; the S0 role ledger; the pairing-v2 mapping ledger; six RESIDE roots; official model, checkpoint, runtime, and v2 entrypoint identities all match exactly

exactly the frozen 150-scene roster per dataset; ITS and OTS exactly match all 300 pairing-v2 rows and 600 distinct nested haze observations by bounded relative path, file SHA-256, decoded RGB SHA-256, aligned dimensions and scoring geometry; Haze4K retains its frozen roster; every clear matches S0; one pairing-SHA-bound input roster is frozen; complete-image inference precedes 16-cell scoring; protected access is zero; and 451 scene-plus-aggregate units complete, including typed invalid units after a pre-inference veto
the un-clipped shifted-target selection null has simultaneous overall UCB below 0.05 dB and every dataset UCB below 0.10 dB when evaluated against the correct target

favorable requires overall primary LCB above 0.10 dB, at least two dataset LCBs above zero and no dataset UCB below zero; aligned-versus-permuted spatial-specificity LCB above 0.05 dB with the same dataset support; equal-dataset material-scene prevalence LCB above 0.20 with at least two dataset LCBs above 0.10 and no dataset UCB below 0.05; and negative-tail prevalence overall UCB below 0.10 and every dataset UCB below 0.15. Any corresponding UCB impossibility is unfavorable; intervals crossing a boundary are indeterminate.

favorable requires cross-observation transferred local maps to beat each target's in-sample dense global oracle with overall LCB above zero and support in at least two datasets; direction-and-exact-strength stable-scene LCB above 0.50; bidirectional-scene LCB above 0.20; keep-supported-scene LCB above 0.20; and same-scene useful-bidirectional prevalence LCB above 0.15, each with predeclared two-dataset support and no-dataset-absence floors. Any corresponding UCB impossibility is unfavorable; intervals crossing a boundary are indeterminate.

after at least 42 near-clear-exposed scenes in at least two datasets, safe means either pooled and sufficiently exposed dataset-specific baseline-damage UCB below 0.10, or pooled and dataset-supported baseline-damage LCB above 0.10 with at least 42 damaged scenes and damage-conditional mitigation LCB above 0.50; unsafe requires material damage plus a conditional mitigation UCB at or below 0.50 in the pooled or sufficiently exposed dataset-specific analysis; all threshold-crossing or underpowered cases are indeterminate
maximum distance from each overall or dataset primary bootstrap estimate to either simultaneous 95 percent interval endpoint; clipping frequencies and raw negative tails remain separately visible

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: An apparent local oracle gain can be produced by incompatible PSNR aggregation, same-pixel action selection, global haze severity needing only one scalar correction, unstable or unresolved directions mislabeled as keep, action histograms without correct spatial placement, crop-boundary context loss, endpoint clipping, an unrelated-target selection artifact, input-identity drift, or pseudoreplication of cells and haze observations.
disabled_actions: confirmation, sealed-final, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, or non-development image access
network training, fitting, fine-tuning, observable-signal prediction, mechanism selection, or candidate promotion
using GT or GT-derived labels as inference-time input

changing either alpha grid, complete-image inference or scoring-crop rule, pairing ledger, cell grid, macroblock split, four-state label rule, direction or keep margin, effect margin, prevalence threshold, precision target, transfer rule, spatial permutation, or null control after outcomes
treating haze observations, cells, pixels, actions, or bootstrap draws as independent samples
interpreting the privileged residual-scaling oracle as a deployable post-processing method
saving or archiving images, arrays, checkpoints, feature maps, action maps, or per-cell tables to GitHub

claiming superiority to arbitrary global restoration operators outside the frozen residual-scaling interval and grid, complete source-provenance disjointness, observable predictability, module effectiveness, deployment readiness, or protected-set generalization
starting S2 or training any adaptive module without a later typed S1 PASS and a separate route-ready contract

precision_contract.rationale: Each bounded scene-level primary value lies in [-0.25, 0.25] dB, giving a distribution-free SD upper bound of 0.25 dB. With simultaneous critical value 2.58 and half-width target 0.055 dB, 138 independent scenes are required per dataset; the frozen plan uses 150 in each stratum.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact frozen official ConvIR-B complete-image inference path pads a 992-by-640 device-aware synthetic input to multiples of 32 before extracting the square scoring crop, then executes the five-action local residual intervention, 8-by-8 macroblock cross-fitting, pooled-SSE aggregation, 1001-point dense global comparator, shifted-target and spatial-permutation controls, four-state classification, tri-state gates, and deterministic known-answer reference cases on CUDA without dataset access or scientific output. The route-manifest-bound pairing-v2 ledger identity fixes the production input roster but remains inaccessible to the synthetic qualification phase.

assurance.planning_sd_rule: The frozen scene-level primary estimand is clipped to [-0.25, 0.25] dB, so Popoviciu's inequality gives the distribution-free planning SD upper bound 0.25 dB without historical outcome or variance reuse.
